acceptanceCriteria: Narrowing is enabled only with the retained 20/5 shadow bar evidence and V1-0760 merged; every FULL condition and the allowlist fail closed, with focused tests for each.
The kill switch trips on the stated thresholds from retained rows and on CORVINT_PR_NARROWING=off; tests cover both and rollback R1 to R3 is exercised or documented.
Required checks go-product, doc-gates and ci-control-plane keep their merge semantics; the queue still runs the full suite on every merge.

Promotion from experimental needs 20 narrowed PRs with complete rows and no trip, plus before/after median and p90 PR wall time, runner-minutes per merged PR and ready-to-merge time over at least 20 merged PRs each; unavailable measurements stay NOT_OBSERVED.
body: Decision 0431 (docs/decisions/0431-merge-queue-backstops-pr-test-selection-2026-10-05.md, PR beamfall/corvint#611) was accepted by the owner on 2026-10-05 with all four open questions answered as recommended: closed allowlist for scope UNKNOWN, shadow bar of 20 complete rows with at least 5 failing, kill switch at 2 MISS or 3 INCOMPLETE rows in the latest 20 plus CORVINT_PR_NARROWING=off for a reviewer-confirmed CHANGE_CAUSED miss, V1-0760 before narrowing and queue group size 1. Queue enablement and merge_group support are CORE-GITHUB-MERGE-QUEUE-COMPATIBILITY-1; main-push reuse of the queue run is V1-0760; the umbrella is V1-0616. Items 3, 4 and 8: once the shadow bar is met (V1-0811) and V1-0760 is merged, PR race shards run only the selected packages. FULL stays for base not main, .github changes, an absent queue rule, and every existing fallback. Scope UNKNOWN narrows only when every plan.unknown entry is in the closed reviewed allowlist (non-go LANGUAGE_FRONTIER, go:build-constraint-variants, go:nested-module-frontier, UNOWNED_DIRTY_PATH, NO_SELECTABLE_TEST); anything else runs FULL. The kill switch reverts PR runs to FULL on 2 or more MISS rows or 3 or more INCOMPLETE rows in the latest 20 forward rows of the current epoch, or when a reviewer sets CORVINT_PR_NARROWING=off after one confirmed CHANGE_CAUSED miss.
